# lumos_user_roles (Data Source)

The Lumos roles assigned to one user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_current_user" "me" {}

# The Lumos roles assigned to a user.
data "lumos_user_roles" "me" {
  user_id = data.lumos_current_user.me.id
}

output "my_roles" {
  value = data.lumos_user_roles.me.roles
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) The UUID of the user whose roles are listed.

### Read-Only

- `roles` (List of String) The roles currently assigned to the user: a built-in role's label, such as `app-admin`, or a custom role's name.
